modelingNotes: Identity: LC1D95 verified in the B8 AC-3 3-pole selection table (PDF p.8 / B8/8): rated operational current in AC-3 at 440 V (theta<=60 C) = 95 A, 45 kW at 400 V; 'instantaneous auxiliary contacts' = 1 NO + 1 NC integral. The basic reference is completed by adding the a.c. control-voltage code.

Coil code P7 = 230 V a.c., 50/60 Hz: verified in the a.c. control-voltage code table (voltage row 24/42/48/110/115/220/230/240/... -> B7/D7/E7/F7/FE7/M7/P7/U7/... , PDF p.8) and stated explicitly on PDF p.4 ('P7 code = 230 V AC'). The a.c. coil is non-polarised. Built-in coil suppression is standard only on D115/D150 a.c. coils, not on D80...D95, so the P7 coil is a plain A1-A2 winding; suppression modules (LA4D...) and control-circuit take-off (LA9D8067) are separately ordered accessories, out of scope for this reference.

Terminal markings from manufacturer scheme 127266 (PDF p.79 / B8/79, 'TeSys D... 3-pole contactors, LC1D09 to D150'), visually inspected: coil A1-A2; three NO make poles 1/L1-2/T1, 3/L2-4/T2, 5/L3-6/T3 (mechanically ganged, coil-actuated); integral auxiliary 1 NO 13-14 and 1 NC 21-22. LC1D95 lies inside the LC1D09...D150 range of this scheme.

Ratings are conditional and kept out of the terminals: AC-3 Ie = 95 A is defined at 440 V; motor power varies with voltage (45 kW/400 V); insulation up to 690 V. No scalar voltage/current is asserted on the main-pole or auxiliary terminals because the load-circuit voltage is application-dependent. Coil terminals A1/A2 carry the assigned 230 V AC (50/60 Hz) supply; frequency 50/60 Hz is recorded here rather than as a scalar.
Manufacturer spelling is 'LC1D95P7' (no hyphen); the source 'LC1-D95P7' hyphen is a presentation separator. Exact ordered reference, not a successor substitution.

No PE/earth terminal appears on the scheme; none is fabricated. All contact functions are switched and the coil actuation is mechanical/functional, so no permanent net joins (fixed links) are asserted.

connectionCoverage.notes: All twelve factory terminals of LC1D95P7 are modeled from the manufacturer scheme: three main NO poles (1/L1-2/T1, 3/L2-4/T2, 5/L3-6/T3), the a.c. coil A1/A2, and the integral 1 NO (13/14) + 1 NC (21/22) auxiliary. Add-on front/side auxiliary blocks, suppression modules and control-circuit take-off are separate accessories and are out of scope. Screw-clamp is the D80...D95 base terminal technology; exact wire ranges and tightening torques are not modeled.
